dictationModal.title: Visit Dictation
dictationModal.instructions: Say “Diagnosis…”, then “Diagnostics…”, then “Treatment plan…” — click stop when done and it fills the chart automatically.
dictationModal.languageHint: Speak in English, Arabic, or French — it’s detected automatically from what you say.
dictationModal.tapToStart: Tap the mic to start recording
dictationModal.recordingStatus: Recording the full visit… Click to stop
dictationModal.liveLabel: Live — what the mic is hearing

promAssignment.shareInstructions: Show this QR code or share the link with the patient — automated WhatsApp/SMS delivery isn't wired up yet (needs a messaging provider chosen separately). Status:
promAssignment.routedToClerk: Routed to the clerk task queue. Status:
promAssignment.deferredReasonPrefix: Marked as deferred. Reason on file:
promAssignment.sendPatientFormDesc: Choose the questionnaire topic. The patient will see it in the mobile app and complete it themselves.
promAssignment.selectAssignDesc: No pre-visit questionnaire is on file for this patient. Choose the instrument and how it should get completed — you direct it, you do not answer for the patient.

self_completion.label: Patient Self-Completion
self_completion.desc: A link/QR code the patient fills in themselves — on their phone or a clinic tablet.

clerk_assisted.label: Clerk-Assisted
clerk_assisted.desc: Routed to the clerk task queue — they read the questions and record only the patient's answers.

physician_assisted.label: Physician-Assisted Now
physician_assisted.desc: Run the questionnaire live — the patient answers, you record it.

deferred.label: Defer / Not Applicable
deferred.desc: Not completed this visit — a reason is kept on file.

promAssignment.deferPlaceholder: e.g. Patient declined today, will complete at next visit.
promAssignment.deferReasonRequiredError: A reason is required to defer.
promAssignment.assignFailedError: Failed to create the assignment. Please try again.

promTrendChart.notEnoughHistory: Not enough visit history yet — needs at least one scored assessment to plot.

printTypeModal.title: Choose Document Type
printTypeModal.subtitle: Select which version of this document to print.

followUpSchedule.title: Follow-Up Call Schedule
followUpSchedule.description: Months after this patient’s first evaluation that a PROM follow-up call gets scheduled.
followUpSchedule.saveNote: Saving regenerates this patient’s not-yet-completed calls from their first evaluation date — already-completed calls are left alone.
followUpSchedule.enterIntervalError: Enter at least one interval, e.g. 3, 6, 9
